name: Drinks recipes
summary: Zero-proof drink recipes for the recipe template. Each post is anchored to a single recipe from libraries/drinks.json — quantities, method, garnish come from there, never invented.
slide_pattern: cover (name + tag) → list (3–5 ingredients with icons) → list or statement (method) → cta
extra_voice_rules: Use the recipe name exactly as in libraries/drinks.json.
Quantities and units come from the library, never invented.
Metric units. Litres, millilitres, grams, centilitres.
No 'try this' or 'you'll love' — recipe posts are about the drink, not the user.
extra_checks: Every ingredient in the post must appear in the source recipe.
Every quantity in the post must equal a quantity in the source recipe.
The recipe's glass and garnish appear in the post if the slide pattern calls for them.
